record.question: A sample of wet soil has a volume of 0.0192m3 and a mass of 32kg. When the sample is dried out in an oven, its mass reduces to 28.5kg. The water content of soil is:
record.explanation: Water mass is 32−28.5 = 3.5 kg. Gravimetric water content is 3.5/28.5 × 100 = 12.28%. No exact official key match is established for this paper in the current archive crosswalk.
